descriptions.value: Jenkins 2.587 and earlier, LTS 2.580.1 and earlier allows attackers with Overall/Read permission to trigger warnings in the "Manage Old Data" feature that can be acted on by administrators to inject attacker-controlled data, overriding existing user account information, including login passwords.
Improper privilege management in Windows Package Manager allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges locally.
